    """Represents an identifier.

    Identifiers may have aliases or typecasts.

    def is_wildcard(self):
        """Return ``True`` if this identifier contains a wildcard."""
        _, token = self.token_next_by(t=T.Wildcard)

All 489 tests pass (2 xfail, 1 xpass as before). 

The fix: `NameAliasMixin.get_real_name()` in `sqlparse/sql.py` previously split on the *first* dot via `token_next_by`, so `db.schema.tbl.col` returned `schema`. It now finds the last top-level dot (skipping any dot nested inside child groups, e.g. inside a `Function`) and returns the first name after it, so the real name is the part after the last dot for any depth. `get_parent_name()` is unchanged (still the first part), and two-part names and qualified function calls behave exactly as before.
